subject: The 6AM workflow your dog wants
preview_text: Our top 1% of users do one thing before breakfast. Your PupShape journey just got a shortcut.
body_paragraphs: I watched 12 owners this week who lost 20%+ of their dog's weight. They all did the same thing: open PupShape at 6AM, before the morning chaos. No guilt, no guessing, just a 90-second routine that sets the day straight.

These power users don't just track meals, they set up their entire day in one tap. They open the app, check the meal plan, log the first meal, and preview exercise recommendations. By the time you're pouring coffee, they've already given their dog a better day. The difference isn't willpower, it's workflow.

Your app has a hidden shortcut: the Daily Summary feature. Top users pin it to their home screen. It shows today's calorie budget, treat allowance, and exercise goal in one glance. No scrolling, no searching, just the numbers that matter. They call it the morning compass.

Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan now and set your Daily Summary as your home screen. It takes 30 seconds. Then tomorrow at 6AM, see how it feels. P.S. The top 1% also log their dog's weight every Tuesday morning, same scale, same time. That single habit doubles their progress speed.
